title: 台付きモニターヘッドホン
description: 地域スタジオや音声編集机に置くヘッドホン一式。左右の閉鎖型イヤーカップ、開口付き楕円クッションと奥の暗い面、連続したアーチ状ヘッドバンド、調整アーム・金具、木色の受けと金属支柱の卓上台、床面に置いたケーブルとプラグを造形。台・線を含め一式1点で、机や音響装置は含みません。再生音、電装、頭部追従・装着変形はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.344 × 0.509 × 0.289 m、6,488三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A headphone assembly for community studios and audio-editing desks. It has two closed-back ear cups, open-centered elliptical cushions with recessed dark interiors, a continuous arched headband, adjustment arms and fittings, a desk stand with wooden-colored cradle/metal post, and a resting cable with plug. Stand and cable are included in one model; desk and audio equipment are absent. Audio playback, electrical operation, head tracking and wearing deformation are not supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.344 × 0.509 × 0.289 m; 6,488 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
